title: material
description: A material (WP2): an instance of a library master or of any material with parameters, a named preset, or a node graph; and the mesh asset slots that wear it. Converged by mat.instance / mat.preset / mat.graph / mat.assign.

path.description: content path of the material or instance, e.g. /Game/Set/Mats/MI_Rock

master.description: a library master (mat.masters); the instance's parent

parent.description: any material or instance content path to be the parent (instead of master)

preset.description: a named look (mat.presets: chrome, glass_clear, emissive_panel, ...); params adjust it

graph.description: a node-graph material (mat.graph's spec: blend, shading, nodes, outputs); builds a Material, not an instance

params.description: parameter values by name: number (scalar, unit per the master's doc), [r, g, b(, a)] linear 0..1 (vector), /Game texture path, true/false (static switch); emissive in nits (Luminance_nits)

assign.description: mesh asset slots that wear this material (every actor showing the mesh changes)
